fire-breath.desc: The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary-resistance.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

heated-body.desc: A creature that touches the azer or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

teleport.manual: O cão leva junto o que veste e carrega, e pode fazer uma mordida antes ou depois de teleportar.
teleport.manualEn: The dog takes what it wears and carries, and may make one bite attack before or after teleporting.
teleport.desc: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dog can make one bite attack.

charge.desc: If the boar moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a tusk attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

relentless.desc: If the boar takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

flyby.desc: The snake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

bite-poison.manual: Se o veneno reduzir o alvo a 0 PV, ele fica estável e envenenado por 1 hora, paralisado enquanto envenenado.
bite-poison.manualEn: If the poison reduces the target to 0 HP, it is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, paralyzed while poisoned.
bite-poison.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

web.manual: Preso: ação para teste de Força CD 12 e se soltar; a teia (CA 10, 5 PV) é vulnerável a fogo.
web.manualEn: Restrained: an action for a DC 12 Strength check to break free; the webbing (AC 10, 5 HP) is vulnerable to fire.
web.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

martial-advantage.desc: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 ft. of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.

death-burst.desc: When the magmin dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature within 10 ft. of it must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried in that area are ignited.

flyby.desc: The owl doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

regeneration.desc: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

pack-tactics.desc: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

undead-fortitude.desc: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.
